blocks.zh: Section 1: Test Methods Part 1 | 試驗方法（一）
blocks.en: Section 1: Test Methods Part 1

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握眼用製劑的通用品質測試（Universal Tests）架構：描述、鑑別、含量測定、雜質、pH、滲透壓、微粒/異物
blocks.en: Master the framework of universal quality tests for ophthalmic products: description, identification, assay, impurities, pH, osmolarity, particulate/foreign matter

blocks.zh: 理解微粒與異物（Particulate and Foreign Matter）的三類分類體系，以及各給藥途徑對應的 USP 章節要求矩陣
blocks.en: Understand the three-category classification system for particulate and foreign matter, and the matrix of USP chapter requirements for each route of administration

blocks.zh: 辨別無菌性（Sterility）要求與抗菌防腐劑（Antimicrobial Preservatives）的各自法規依據與邊界條件
blocks.en: Distinguish the regulatory basis and boundary conditions of the sterility requirement and of antimicrobial preservatives

blocks.zh: 了解細菌內毒素（Bacterial Endotoxins）限量規定及其適用劑型範圍
blocks.en: Understand the bacterial endotoxins limits and the range of dosage forms to which they apply

blocks.zh: Drug Product Quality — Universal Tests 概述 | 藥品品質—通用測試
blocks.en: Drug Product Quality — Universal Tests Overview

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 品質測試（Quality Tests）vs 效能測試（Performance Tests）的根本區分：
blocks.en: The fundamental distinction between quality tests and performance tests:

blocks.zh: 品質測試：確認劑型「存在的完整性」——無菌、純度、含量、微粒、pH。由 〈771〉 管轄。
blocks.en: Quality tests: confirm the "integrity of what is there" in the dosage form: sterility, purity, content, particulates, pH. Governed by <771>.

blocks.zh: 效能測試：確認藥物「能否從劑型釋放出來進入眼組織」——溶出、藥物釋放。由 〈1771〉 管轄。
blocks.en: Performance tests: confirm whether the drug "can be released from the dosage form into the ocular tissue": dissolution, drug release. Governed by <1771>.

blocks.zh: 這個分工類似於「食品安全檢查」vs「食物營養標示」：前者確保食品沒有問題，後者確保食品有預期價值。兩者合在一起才能保證藥品有效且安全。
blocks.en: This division of labor is similar to "food safety inspection" versus "nutrition labeling": the former ensures that the food has no problems, the latter that the food has its intended value. Only together do they ensure that the drug product is both effective and safe.

blocks.zh: Stability-indicating assay（穩定性指示性試驗）：含量測試方法必須能夠區分原藥與其降解產物，不能因為降解物的存在而高估或低估主藥含量。這是 ICH Q2 驗證的核心要求之一。
blocks.en: Stability-indicating assay: the assay method must be able to distinguish the drug substance from its degradation products, so that the presence of degradants does not cause the active content to be over- or underestimated. This is one of the core requirements of ICH Q2 validation.

blocks.zh: 關鍵數字 Key Numbers
blocks.en: Key Numbers

blocks.zh:
正常淚液 pH：7.4
眼部可耐受 pH 範圍：3.0 ~ 8.6
（根據緩衝能力而定）

眼部可耐受滲透壓範圍：
  171 ~ 1711 mOsm/kg
  相當於 0.5% ~ 5% NaCl 當量

等張標準（目標）：
  ~308 mOsm/kg（相當於 0.9% NaCl）

低張 < 等張 < 高張
耐受性：低張 > 高張
blocks.en:
Normal tear pH: 7.4
Tolerable pH range for the eye: 3.0 ~ 8.6
(depending on buffer capacity)

Tolerable osmolarity range for the eye:
  171 ~ 1711 mOsm/kg
  equivalent to 0.5% ~ 5% NaCl equivalent

Isotonic standard (target):
  ~308 mOsm/kg (equivalent to 0.9% NaCl)

Hypotonic < isotonic < hypertonic
Tolerability: hypotonic > hypertonic

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: pH 與緩衝能力的平衡：想像把檸檬汁（pH≈2）倒入眼睛，即使稀釋到 pH 4.0，如果緩衝能力強（像是加了很多磷酸緩衝液），淚液無法快速中和，刺激時間就會很長。但如果緩衝能力低，淚液很快就能把 pH 拉回 7.4，患者幾乎感覺不到刺激。
blocks.en: Balancing pH and buffer capacity: imagine pouring lemon juice (pH ≈ 2) into the eye. Even if it is diluted to pH 4.0, if the buffer capacity is strong (as if a lot of phosphate buffer had been added), the tears cannot neutralize it quickly and the irritation lasts a long time. If the buffer capacity is low, however, the tears quickly pull the pH back to 7.4 and the patient hardly feels any irritation.

blocks.zh: 所以開發眼用配方時，極端 pH（如 pH 3.0）需要搭配低緩衝能力，才能在臨床上被患者接受。
blocks.en: So when developing an ophthalmic formulation, an extreme pH (such as pH 3.0) needs to be paired with low buffer capacity to be clinically acceptable to patients.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 鑑別測試的特異性規則：USP 明確規定「單一色譜保留時間不構成特異性鑑別」。這意味著必須結合質譜、UV 光譜、或其他正交方法（orthogonal methods）才能通過鑑別要求。在申請藥品上市許可時，分析方法章節常見的審查意見之一就是鑑別特異性不足。
blocks.en: The specificity rule for identification tests: USP expressly states that "a single chromatographic retention time does not constitute specific identification". This means that mass spectrometry, UV spectra or other orthogonal methods must be combined with it to meet the identification requirement. When applying for marketing authorization, one of the most common review comments on the analytical methods section is insufficient identification specificity.

blocks.zh: 滲透壓包材影響：眼藥水長期儲存中，包裝材料（特別是 LDPE 瓶）可能吸收水分或釋放可溶性物質，影響滲透壓。貨架壽命穩定性研究中應特別監測此參數。
blocks.en: Effect of packaging materials on osmolarity: during long-term storage of eye drops, the packaging material (especially LDPE bottles) may absorb water or release soluble substances, affecting osmolarity. This parameter should be monitored closely in shelf-life stability studies.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 某眼藥水含量測定方法為 HPLC，只測保留時間，未做光譜確認。這個方法符合 USP 〈771〉 的鑑別要求嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: An eye drop assay method is HPLC, measuring only retention time, with no spectral confirmation. Does this method meet the identification requirement of USP <771>? Why?

blocks.zh: 配方開發人員想把眼藥水 pH 設定在 4.5（偏低但在耐受範圍內）以提升藥物穩定性，應採取什麼措施來提高患者耐受性？
blocks.en: A formulation developer wants to set the pH of an eye drop at 4.5 (on the low side but within the tolerable range) to improve drug stability. What measures should be taken to improve patient tolerability?

blocks.zh: Particulate and Foreign Matter | 微粒與異物
blocks.en: Particulate and Foreign Matter

blocks.zh: 三類微粒分類（Extrinsic / Intrinsic / Inherent）是監管審查的核心框架：
blocks.en: The three-category particulate classification (extrinsic / intrinsic / inherent) is the core framework of regulatory review:

blocks.zh: Extrinsic（外源性）：來自外部污染，如纖維、玻璃碎片、操作員掉落物——製造過程控制失效的標誌，監管最不能接受
blocks.en: Extrinsic: comes from external contamination, such as fibers, glass fragments or items dropped by operators; a sign that process control has failed, and the category regulators accept least

blocks.zh: Intrinsic（固有性）：來自配方、製程或容器密封系統本身——蛋白質聚集、矽油液滴、降解產物等——需要系統性控制策略
blocks.en: Intrinsic: comes from the formulation, the process, or the container closure system itself, such as protein aggregates, silicone oil droplets and degradation products; requires a systematic control strategy

blocks.zh: Inherent（本質性）：產品本身預期存在的物理狀態——如懸浮液的藥物微粒——需建立可接受範圍
blocks.en: Inherent: a physical state that is expected to be present in the product itself, such as the drug particles of a suspension; an acceptable range needs to be established

blocks.zh: 100% unit inspection（100% 單元檢驗）：每一個容器都要接受目視或自動化非破壞性檢查，確認包裝完整性與內容物可接受性。這是眼用製劑的基本要求，不同於一般藥品可能採用的抽樣檢查。
blocks.en: 100% unit inspection: every container must undergo visual or automated non-destructive inspection to confirm package integrity and the acceptability of the contents. This is a basic requirement for ophthalmic products, unlike the sampling inspection that may be used for ordinary drug products.

blocks.zh: 三類微粒就像餐廳食物裡發現的異物：
blocks.en: The three categories of particulates are like foreign objects found in restaurant food:

blocks.zh: Extrinsic：湯裡有頭髮或鉛筆屑 → 廚房衛生出問題，立刻令客人退餐，餐廳面臨投訴
blocks.en: Extrinsic: a hair or pencil shavings in the soup → a kitchen hygiene failure; the customer sends it back immediately and the restaurant faces a complaint

blocks.zh: Intrinsic：炒菜油在低溫下凝固成白色顆粒 → 因製程（溫度管理）或食材（油脂種類）引起，可以透過配方調整解決
blocks.en: Intrinsic: cooking oil solidifying into white granules at low temperature → caused by the process (temperature management) or the ingredients (type of fat), and can be solved by adjusting the formulation

blocks.zh: Inherent：柳橙汁裡的果肉 → 本來就該有，需要告知消費者並建立「果肉量」的可接受範圍
blocks.en: Inherent: the pulp in orange juice → it is supposed to be there; consumers need to be told, and an acceptable range for "pulp content" needs to be established

blocks.zh: 微粒要求的關鍵升級點：Table 1 的核心規律是：
blocks.en: The key escalation points in particulate requirements: the core pattern of Table 1 is:

blocks.zh: 所有眼用製劑（包括局部）都需符合 〈790〉 可見微粒
blocks.en: All ophthalmic products (including topical) must meet <790> visible particulates

blocks.zh: 眼外（非局部）注射追加 〈788〉 亞可見微粒（光遮蔽法）
blocks.en: Extraocular (non-topical) injections additionally require <788> subvisible particulates (light obscuration method)

blocks.zh: 眼內注射（穿透邊界組織者）追加 〈789〉 亞可見微粒（針對眼內溶液的更嚴格標準）
blocks.en: Intraocular injections (those that penetrate boundary tissues) additionally require <789> subvisible particulates (a stricter standard for intraocular solutions)

blocks.zh: 蛋白質生物製劑配方可用 〈787〉 代替 〈788〉，因傳統光遮蔽法對蛋白質聚集體不適用。
blocks.en: Protein biologic formulations may use <787> in place of <788>, because the traditional light obscuration method is not suitable for protein aggregates.

blocks.zh: 軟膏、懸浮液等非透明劑型無法直接做目視可見微粒檢查，需採用替代方法（如顯微鏡檢查、光遮蔽法）並以統計抽樣確定批次可接受性。
blocks.en: Non-transparent dosage forms such as ointments and suspensions cannot be directly inspected for visible particulates; alternative methods (such as microscopic examination or light obscuration) must be used, with statistical sampling to establish batch acceptability.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 假設 CDMO 承接一款玻璃體內注射用蛋白質眼科藥物（Intravitreal biologic），根據 Table 1，品質測試策略需包含：
blocks.en: Suppose a CDMO takes on a protein ophthalmic drug for intravitreal injection (an intravitreal biologic). According to Table 1, the quality testing strategy must include:

blocks.zh: 〈790〉 可見微粒：100% 自動化目視檢查（AVI）+ 人工 MVI
blocks.en: <790> visible particulates: 100% automated visual inspection (AVI) + manual visual inspection (MVI)

blocks.zh: 〈789〉 亞可見微粒（眼內溶液專屬，比 〈788〉 更嚴格）
blocks.en: <789> subvisible particulates (specific to intraocular solutions, stricter than <788>)

blocks.zh: 〈787〉（代替 〈788〉，因為是蛋白質生物製劑）
blocks.en: <787> (in place of <788>, because it is a protein biologic)

blocks.zh: 內毒素、無菌性、pH、滲透壓均需包括
blocks.en: Endotoxins, sterility, pH and osmolarity must all be included

blocks.zh: 這些測試項目需在品質協議（Quality Agreement）和規格表中一一列明。
blocks.en: These test items need to be listed one by one in the Quality Agreement and the specification sheet.

blocks.zh: 一瓶眼用懸浮液，懸浮顆粒本身屬於哪類微粒（Extrinsic/Intrinsic/Inherent）？如果懸浮顆粒聚集結塊，應歸為哪類？
blocks.en: For a bottle of ophthalmic suspension, which category of particulate (extrinsic/intrinsic/inherent) do the suspended particles themselves belong to? If the suspended particles aggregate and cake, which category should they be assigned to?

blocks.zh: 某批玻璃體內注射液目視檢查通過，但 〈789〉 超標。這批次能放行嗎？為什麼？
blocks.en: A batch of intravitreal injection passes visual inspection but exceeds the <789> limit. Can this batch be released? Why?

blocks.zh: Sterility | 無菌性
blocks.en: Sterility

blocks.zh: 無菌性（Sterility）在眼用製劑的地位：根據本章所有要求，無菌是最基礎的前提條件——眼球不具備像腸道那樣的天然菌叢保護機制，任何微生物污染都可能引發嚴重眼部感染（如眼內炎，endophthalmitis），甚至導致失明。因此無菌保證是眼用製劑中不可妥協的優先事項。
blocks.en: The place of sterility in ophthalmic products: according to all the requirements of this chapter, sterility is the most basic prerequisite. The eye has no natural flora protection mechanism like the intestinal tract, and any microbial contamination may cause a serious eye infection (such as endophthalmitis) and even blindness. Sterility assurance is therefore a non-negotiable priority for ophthalmic products.

blocks.zh: 抗菌防腐劑的豁免條件（四條例外）：多劑量製劑原則上必須加防腐劑，但四種情況可豁免，其中最重要的是條件 4——容器密封系統（Container-Closure System）本身能維持無菌並維持使用期間抗菌效果，這是目前無防腐劑多劑量眼藥水的技術創新方向。
blocks.en: Conditions for exemption from antimicrobial preservatives (four exceptions): multi-dose preparations must in principle contain a preservative, but four situations are exempt. The most important is condition 4: the container-closure system itself maintains sterility and maintains antimicrobial effectiveness during use. This is the current direction of technical innovation for preservative-free multi-dose eye drops.

blocks.zh: 細菌內毒素限量 Endotoxin Limits
blocks.en: Endotoxin Limits

blocks.zh:
眼部灌洗製劑：≤ 0.5 EU/mL
注射/植入眼用製劑：≤ 2.0 EU/dose/eye

比較：靜脈注射一般限量 = 5 EU/kg/hr
      腰椎穿刺注射限量 = 0.2 EU/mL（最嚴格）

眼用注射介於兩者之間。
局部眼藥水：通常不要求內毒素測試。
blocks.en:
Ophthalmic irrigation preparations: ≤ 0.5 EU/mL
Injectable/implantable ophthalmic preparations: ≤ 2.0 EU/dose/eye

For comparison: general intravenous injection limit = 5 EU/kg/hr
      intrathecal (lumbar puncture) injection limit = 0.2 EU/mL (the strictest)

Ophthalmic injections fall between the two.
Topical eye drops: endotoxin testing is usually not required.

blocks.zh: 眼用製劑的多劑量防腐劑要求，就像餐廳的「自助取用醬料瓶」問題：開封後每次都有人用湯匙舀取，如果沒有任何抗菌機制，幾天後瓶裡就滋生細菌。解決方案有兩種：
blocks.en: The multi-dose preservative requirement for ophthalmic products is like the problem of a restaurant's self-service sauce bottle: after opening, people scoop from it with a spoon every time, and with no antimicrobial mechanism at all, bacteria will grow in the bottle within a few days. There are two solutions:

blocks.zh: 加防腐劑（如苯扎氯銨）= 在醬料裡加防腐成分，但有些人對防腐劑過敏（長期使用眼藥水的患者如青光眼患者）
blocks.en: Add a preservative (such as benzalkonium chloride) = add a preserving ingredient to the sauce, but some people are allergic to preservatives (patients who use eye drops long term, such as glaucoma patients)

blocks.zh: 特殊包裝系統（無菌自封閥）= 瓶口設計讓外界細菌進不去，每次取用後自動密封——這是現代無防腐劑多劑量眼藥水的設計思路
blocks.en: Special packaging system (sterile self-sealing valve) = a bottle-mouth design that keeps outside bacteria out and reseals automatically after each use; this is the design thinking behind modern preservative-free multi-dose eye drops

blocks.zh: 容器（直接容器）需在灌裝時就是無菌的：這是製造工藝的直接要求。生產前容器清洗、去熱原、滅菌（如 DET 隧道爐）均是關鍵製程步驟，任何偏差都可能導致批次報廢。
blocks.en: The container (primary container) must already be sterile at filling: this is a direct requirement of the manufacturing process. Container washing, depyrogenation and sterilization before production (such as a DET tunnel oven) are all critical process steps, and any deviation may lead to batch rejection.

blocks.zh: 內毒素測試的適用邊界：局部眼藥水通常不要求，但一旦穿透眼組織（注射、植入），就必須嚴格控制。眼球的血-眼屏障（blood-ocular barrier）一旦被注射行為打破，內毒素就可能進入全身循環，引發嚴重炎症反應。
blocks.en: The boundary of applicability of endotoxin testing: usually not required for topical eye drops, but once ocular tissue is penetrated (injection, implantation), it must be strictly controlled. Once the blood-ocular barrier of the eye is broken by the act of injection, endotoxin may enter the systemic circulation and trigger a severe inflammatory reaction.

blocks.zh: 一個無防腐劑多劑量眼藥水使用「COMOD 系統」（特殊氮氣加壓瓶），開封後可使用 6 個月。這個產品豁免防腐劑的法規依據是四條例外中的哪一條？需要什麼驗證證明？
blocks.en: A preservative-free multi-dose eye drop uses the "COMOD system" (a special nitrogen-pressurized bottle) and can be used for 6 months after opening. Under which of the four exceptions is this product exempt from preservatives, and what validation is needed as proof?

blocks.zh: 玻璃體內注射製劑的細菌內毒素限量是 2.0 EU/dose/eye。若一劑注射量為 0.05 mL，每毫升的允許上限是多少 EU/mL？
blocks.en: The bacterial endotoxins limit for intravitreal injections is 2.0 EU/dose/eye. If one dose has an injection volume of 0.05 mL, what is the permissible upper limit per milliliter in EU/mL?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 眼用製劑品質測試分兩大類：通用品質測試（鑑別、含量、雜質、pH、滲透壓、微粒）和效能測試（溶出/藥物釋放，另由 〈1771〉 管轄）
blocks.en: Quality tests for ophthalmic products fall into two broad groups: universal quality tests (identification, assay, impurities, pH, osmolarity, particulates) and performance tests (dissolution/drug release, governed separately by <1771>)

blocks.zh: 微粒三類分類框架（Extrinsic / Intrinsic / Inherent）決定控制策略層次；Table 1 明確各給藥途徑的微粒章節要求，眼內注射要求最嚴（〈790〉+〈789〉）
blocks.en: The three-category particulate framework (extrinsic / intrinsic / inherent) determines the tier of control strategy; Table 1 specifies the particulate chapter requirements for each route of administration, with intraocular injection the strictest (<790> + <789>)

blocks.zh: 無菌性是眼用製劑最基礎要求；多劑量製劑必須有抗菌防腐系統（或符合四項豁免之一）
blocks.en: Sterility is the most basic requirement for ophthalmic products; multi-dose preparations must have an antimicrobial preservative system (or meet one of the four exemptions)

blocks.zh: 細菌內毒素限量：灌洗液 ≤0.5 EU/mL，注射/植入 ≤2.0 EU/dose/eye；局部製劑通常免測
blocks.en: Bacterial endotoxins limits: irrigation solutions ≤0.5 EU/mL, injectable/implantable ≤2.0 EU/dose/eye; topical preparations are usually exempt from testing
